connect_pybullet_gui: connect to the pybullet physics server in GUI mode for visual simulation
load_urdf_model: load a URDF robot model file into the pybullet simulation at a given position
get_num_joints: query the number of joints on a loaded pybullet object
set_gravity: set the gravity acceleration vector for the pybullet physics simulation
step_simulation: step the pybullet physics simulation forward and query object position and orientation
